{{Top|leg}}
'''Sangorn's Net''' was a bar that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was popular with criminals. The [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent [[Fulkrehm Protial]] once went on an undercover mission there, in disguise as a drunk.
